gap: No result ChatGPT got states what each front-and-rear camera costs once the maker's own hardwire kit for parking mode is added: ChatGPT's two top cards, the 70mai A810S and Vantrue S1 Pro, both pass $150 with the kit, while DDPAI's Z50 Pro Dual GPS + Hardwire Kit variant comes to $139.92 with code SAVEBIGBF.
standout_why: Compared against four of the five cited pages (dashpicked.com, dashcamtalk.com, knowledgelib.io, carcody.com). dashpicked and knowledgelib say the kit is 'sold separately' with no price; dashcamtalk and carcody give no kit price or total. None adds camera + kit, and none gives hours per card. ChatGPT's answer itself says 'factor those into your $150 limit' but does no sum. Car and Driver (cited) refused the fetch and thecargearguide.com (uncited) failed on a certificate error, so neither was compared. Held at 2, not 3, because the 70mai inputs are lowest-variant prices from the store's search listing (product pages returned HTTP 429), and SAVEBIGBF was not cart-tested on the Z50 Pro itself.
decides: For a shopper whose $150 covers parking mode, the pick moves off ChatGPT's top cards. The 70mai A810S comes to at least $167.98 and the Vantrue S1 Pro 2CH to $160.98–$165.98 with a kit. The DDPAI Z50 Pro Dual GPS + Hardwire Kit comes to $139.92 with SAVEBIGBF (code ends 2026-11-30), and the DDPAI N3 Pro Dual GPS + Hardwire Kit to $95.92; both are partner-store products with no record yet. For camera only, the A810S ($139.99 lowest variant), S1 Pro 2CH ($135.99), Z50 Pro Dual GPS ($131.12 with code) and Botslab G980H dual ($109.87 with code AA18) all fit, so this angle does not separate them there.
